title: Oath & Action, Research brief 01, page 3: Executive summary (studio sample)
headline: A useful question
has a clear address.
intro: A town allocates 100 units of its budget to one public service, and a resident asks about its hours.
sections: 40 units fund public hours, 35 support facilities and 25 pay for access.
The resident submits a question. A clerk places it on an agenda, the council considers it with the evidence, and the council office publishes the decision with its reasons.
Work and caring responsibilities can make a published schedule hard to use.
sources: Sources: Town budget, fiscal 2026, table 4; town clerk, public comment procedure, section 3.
